recommendation: Keep the fix. It completes the current-build Population datatype removal for FHIR-31853 without expanding into the separate ClinicalUseIssue-to-ClinicalUseDefinition rename cleanup family.
issue_request: FHIR-31853 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BRR change request for R5 ClinicalUseIssue/ClinicalUseDefinition. It reported that ClinicalUseIssue pointed to the draft Population datatype and requested use of Group instead; the final resolution was to use the Group resource and remove the Population datatype.
initial_application: The main resource change was applied by 0d13844f22f42bb7ddf72c329b24228e76040624 and 08d35148dd0fa3866502882e1805fe34cb107da4, changing ClinicalUseDefinition.population from Population to Reference(Group). Current ClinicalUseDefinition source and its indication example already use a Group reference.
additional_context: FHIR-31847 renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition immediately before this issue was applied. source/fhir.ini comments Population out of active datatype, type-page, and normative build lists, so the leftover Population spreadsheet/page are inactive; however, Library is active and Library/library-fhir-model-definition is registered, and that ModelInfo Library still exposed FHIR.Population.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to remove the obsolete FHIR.Population ClassInfo and retarget remaining population properties that referenced it to list-valued FHIR.Reference. Synchronized source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its embedded attachment matches the raw ModelInfo content.

source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: regenerated the embedded Library data attachment from the updated ModelInfo content.
